data.name: Haashimah
data.gender_notes: Haashimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haashimah is a female name derived from the Arabic word 'haashim' which means 'breaker of chains'. It is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's great-grandfather, Hashim ibn Abd Manaf, who was a leader of the Quraish tribe and known for his generosity and hospitality. The name Haashimah carries the meaning “Breaker of chains” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Haashimah usually hope their child will grow to embody breaker of chains and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing strength and generosity.
data.etymology: Haashimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breaker of chains.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haashimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: هشيمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: هشيمة من كلمات مأخوذة من الجذر العربي 'شِم'، والتي تعني "الذكاء" و"الاستبصار". وتُشير إلى فطنة، ذكاء، وخبرة عالية. ويرتبط اسم "هشيمة" بالمهارات الفكرية والقدرة على التخطيط والتفكير الاستراتيجي، فضلاً عن تحقيق النجاح والنجاة من الأخطار. ويمثل هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية مفهومًا متقدمًا للبصيرة والرؤية الواضحة للأمور.

in_urdu.name: حشیمہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حشیمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو "شِم" کے ریشم سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے "بصیرت، ہوش، اور عقل مندِی". یہ نام ذہانت، فطنت، اور حکمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تہذیب میں، حشیمہ نام حِکمت، بصیرت اور عقل مند کے صفات کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے مناسب سمجھا جاتا ہے جو عقل مند ہیں اور زندگی میں کامیاب ہونے کی صلاحیت رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हशिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: हशिम एक अरबी नाम है जो मूलतः 'शِम' जड़ से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'बुद्धि' और 'समझदारी'. यह नाम दूरदर्शिता, बुद्धिमत्ता और विवेक को दर्शाता है. इस्लामी परंपरा में हशिम नाम बुद्धिमानी, सावधानी और सफलता से जुड़ा हुआ है. यह नाम उन बच्चों के लिए उपयुक्त माना जाता है जो बुद्धिमान और सफल होकर जीवन में आगे बढ़ना चाहते हैं.

in_pashto.name: هشیمه
in_pashto.long_meaning: هشیمه نوم پښتو او عربي لهجه کې ته د "هوش" او "درایت" څخه راځي. د بشري خپرا له توکې کا لوستره، د لارې او ګڼ کس ګڼو ته وګرځي. هشیمه نوم د ښه او عقل مند انسان دی چې د نړۍ ته ورغډ وکړي.

in_english.name: Haashimah
in_english.long_meaning: Haashimah is an Arabic name derived from the root "shm", meaning "intelligence", "wisdom", and "success". It signifies astuteness, discernment, and profound understanding. In Islamic tradition, Haashimah embodies qualities of intellect, insight, and the ability to navigate life's challenges with wisdom. It is often associated with individuals who are intelligent, perceptive, and achieve success in their endeavors.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The name Haashimah holds a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the name of a revered figure in Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad's great-grandfather Hashim. His leadership, generosity, and hospitality are traits that are highly valued in Islamic culture, and the name Haashimah serves as a reminder of these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Haashimah conveys the idea of breaking free from the chains of adversity or hardship. This could be interpreted as a call to overcome challenges and obstacles in life, and to seek inner strength and resilience in the face of difficulties. Additionally, the name may be seen as a reminder of the power of generosity and hospitality, and the impact that such acts can have on one's spiritual growth and development.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Haashimah: Derived from the name of Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham's) second son, Isma'il's (Ishmael's) grandson, Hassan ibn Ali. Haashimah signifies one who is generous, kind, and compassionate, embodying the spirit of the Prophet's noble progeny.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Haashimah bint Abdul-Muttalib was the mother of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Haashimah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Haashimah is a prominent figure in Islamic history as the mother of the Prophet Muhammad.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Haashimah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Haashimah in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Haashimah, which means "Breaker of chains". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
